title: security: rbac-v2 - enforce KMS region pinning and audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 controls for KMS key residency and audit logging so customers can enforce data residency and provide stronger audit trails. This PR adds an enforcement path for KMS region pinning, improves audit events for RBAC policy changes, and hardens validators to prevent misconfiguration during rollout. Changes include policy schema bumps, server-side enforcement hooks, and migration tooling for existing tenants.

What this PR does: - Introduces a new enforcement flag policy.rbac_v2.kms_residency.enforce which, when enabled for an organization, rejects requests that attempt to use keys outside of pinned regions. - Adds KMS region metadata on audit events for Create/Update/Delete operations that touch key-resident resources. - Adds server-side validation to deny creating RBAC bindings that would violate org-level KMS residency policies. - Migration utility to scan existing bindings and surface offender list with remediation suggestions. - Integration tests for enforcement and audit payloads; unit tests for validator logic.

Rollout plan: ship behind feature flag (rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce) scoped to internal orgs first, run the migration scanner, contact impacted customers with remediation guidance, enable enforcement for a small pilot org, monitor audit logs and SLOs, then progressively roll out.

Checklist: - [x] Implementation and unit tests - [x] Integration tests against a local KMS test harness - [x] Migration scanner and remediation docs - [x] CI green after lint fix (see comments) - [x] Security review by Priya - [x] Added release notes and upgrade guidance

Related: ENG-4872, SEC-1021, SUP-2145. More context in the design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4872/rbac-v2-kms-residency-design (internal).

reviews: Liam Chen: left minor nits around error messages and suggested a clearer log line when enforcement rejects a request. Verified unit tests and integration smoke — APPROVED after nits.

Priya Narang: security review completed; requested explicit audit event for policy admin operations and confirmation that KMS ARNs are never logged in plaintext. Added comment: please redact sensitive fields in audit payloads. Author addressed and added redaction layer. APPROVED.

Ethan Morales: asked about performance impact of enforcement checks on hot paths; author added bench results showing <0.5% p99 regression with caching, and added an LRU cache to reduce policy lookup. Approved after bench addition.

CI: re-run - all checks pass, integration suite ran but one flaky e2e failed on unrelated infra; rerun e2e in separate workflow and passed
release_notes: Enforced KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 (opt-in via feature flag). Audit events now include kms_region metadata and redact sensitive KMS identifiers. Migration scanner added to identify existing bindings that violate residency policies. See docs/releases/2025-02-rbac-kms-residency.md for upgrade and remediation steps.
notes: Follow-up: add telemetry metrics for enforcement rejects (rbac.kms_residency.reject_count) and dashboard. Coordinate with support for impacted customers. Consider a migration job to auto-remediate trivial cases in v2.1.
security_impact: moderate - adds enforcement to prevent cross-region key usage; careful rollout required to avoid customer impact
qa_summary: Integration tests cover enforcement path and audit payloads; manual validation performed against a local KMS emulator and one internal org pilot; no data plane changes introduced; regression testing completed.
